test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain sum amounts to ₹12,096 in 2 years and to ₹12,852 in 3 years at x% p.a., interest compounded yearly. What will be the simple interest (in ₹) on a sum of ₹15,000 at (x + 4)% p.a. in 5 years?
solution:
Formula:

SI = Ptimes Rtimes Tover100

CI = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

where-

P = Principal

SI = Simple Interest

R = Rate

T = Time

CI = Compound Interest

Calculation:

CI for 3rd year = ₹12,852 - ₹12,096 = Rs 756

⇒ This CI was charged on the amount for the 2nd year i.e., ₹12,096.

Rate of Interest = 756over 12,096 × 100 = 6.25%

Rate for SI = 6.25 + 4 = 10.25%

∴ SI = 15,000times 10.25times 5over100 = 7,687.50

**The SI for the amount is Rs 7,687.50.**

8d:T
